reason: The 15 to 20 minute sessions actually fit a nap, so I'd grab the free week, but I've started a dozen free programs and never finished one. I already get postpartum core stuff free on YouTube, so I'm not paying until I know I'll actually stick with it.
objection: It's not the $20, it's me. I'll do two sessions, the baby will stop napping properly or get sick, and it'll sit there unused like everything else. And how is this really different from the free postpartum videos I already save and never do?
would_change_my_mind: If I actually got through all 4 free sessions in the quick-start week during naps and the diastasis check showed I have a gap that the YouTube stuff isn't dealing with, I'd pay the $19.99.
